description_en: Adds or removes security alerts detected by the agentless detection feature to or from the whitelist
description_zh: 将无代理检测功能检测出的安全告警加入或移出白名单
name: HandleMaliciousFiles

parameters.help_en:
The type of operation. Valid values:
addWhitelist: adds to the whitelist.
offWhitelist: removes from the whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
操作的类型：
addWhitelist：加白名单
offWhitelist：移除白名单
parameters.name: operation

parameters.help_en:
The list of file IDs to process.
You can call [ListAgentlessMaliciousFiles](~~ListAgentlessMaliciousFiles~~) to obtain the IDs.
-
parameters.help_zh:
处理的文件ID列表。
您可以调用[ListAgentlessMaliciousFiles](~~ListAgentlessMaliciousFiles~~)获取ID。
-
parameters.name: file_id_list
